thread:
Seattle U has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus than Washington, Gonzaga and Central Washington combined.

Every Washington college with 5,000+ students:

1. Seattle U: 241
2. Washington: 70
3. Gonzaga: 38
4. Central Washington: 18
5. Eastern Washington: 10
6. Washington State: 8
7. Western Washington: 7
8. UW Bothell: 6

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/wa
